contexts.text: Also straw () = memory truths... because it is predicated of the camels... by which is signified the natural man as to the general scientifics therein; and therefore their food, which is straw, must have this signification... for if such food were to fail the natural man, namely, knowing, it could not subsist.

The truths of the natural man are memory truths, that is, whatever truths are in his external memory; and these are what are signified by straw, when camels, horses, mules, and donkeys are treated of.
He gave straw and fodder for the camels () = instruction in truths and goods. Straw = the truths of the natural man.
She put them in the camel's straw () = in scientifics... They are called straw, both because it is the food of a camel, and because they are relatively gross and inordinated. Explained. AC 4157.
The lion shall eat straw like the ox (). (See Ox.)
Straw = the Word in the letter which is perverted by infernal falsity; but cannot be perverted by those who are in truths from good.
